$comment: Pins for the bundled engine runtime. Edit versions here, then run `node scripts/runtime/lock.mjs` to refresh checksums, packaging/requirements/*.txt and packaging/ffmpeg/*.txt. Built by scripts/runtime/bundle.mjs.

vstudio.$comment: Copied at build time from this monorepo's root (apps/desk -> ../..; VSTUDIO_ENGINE_SRC overrides), never fetched: include = top-level entries copied, exclude = directory names dropped anywhere. runtime.json / COMMIT record the checkout's git HEAD.

pip.$comment: Added to the pinned repo's requirements.txt per target. torch is overridden away (mlx-whisper only needs it to convert checkpoints); so is scipy (App Review 2.5.1: its extensions import non-public Accelerate BLAS symbols; the engine is scipy-free and mlx-whisper's one call is patched by scripts/runtime/patch_mlx_whisper.py). darwin-arm64 also carries onnxruntime (MIT; the other targets already have it through faster-whisper) for the cover engine (BiRefNet subject cutout, CLIP aesthetic score), and the free offline voice: Kokoro-82M via mlx-audio (MIT) + misaki G2P (Apache-2.0; zh: jieba/pypinyin/cn2an, en: spaCy + en_core_web_sm, MIT). Dropped for it: transformers (mlx-audio's Kokoro path never imports it), espeak-ng (espeakng-loader / phonemizer-fork, GPL: misaki's English fallback for out-of-dictionary words, which are then skipped), spacy-curated-transformers (+torch, only for en_core_web_trf), pypinyin-dict (110 MB, only misaki's Kokoro v1.1-zh frontend; the v1.0 weights use misaki.zh without it) and num2words (LGPL: replaced by vstudio.numwords_en); scripts/runtime/patch_kokoro.py makes mlx-audio / misaki run without them. The Kokoro weights are a first-run download (packaging/assets.json group tts-kokoro), not in the installer.
pip.$sdist: Pure-Python packages PyPI has no wheel for, built from their hash-pinned sdist (pip --no-binary; everything else stays --only-binary). jieba (MIT): misaki's Chinese word segmentation.
pip.$mediapipe: Mac ARM uses 0.10.21, whose official wheel contains no Clearcut metrics uploader. Its Tasks vision API is verified with NumPy 2 (real 478-point detection and segmentation). Override its conservative numpy<2 metadata to retain the existing numerical stack. Its opencv-contrib-python dependency supplies cv2; avoid the competing opencv-python wheel. JAX/JAXLIB are unused optional task dependencies, excluded to keep the runtime SciPy-free. Other targets retain their existing dependency graph.

ffmpeg.$comment: conda-forge LGPL build (configure --disable-gpl --enable-version3, shared libs). No libx264/libx265: H.264 comes from VideoToolbox (mac), Media Foundation (Windows) or OpenH264.
